conceptZh: 賽車脫鞋脫太用力，鞋子彈來彈去，每碰一下落一筆。
object: a squeaky pull-back toy race car with googly eyes, shoes and socks
morph: a flying shoe ricochets, each hit dropping one stroke of 脫
creativeAngle: 賽車脫掉鞋子，鞋子像彈珠般亂彈，每一彈落下一個部件。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a bright lime-and-cream backdrop with checkered floor stripes. Lead: a squeaky pull-back toy race car, cherry red, with large googly eyes who always overshoots. The finished glyph 脫 is a saturated emerald-green, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.6s: the car revs back on its springs, wearing sneakers on all four wheels. First "脫" as he squeals and shakes his front left sneaker off.
1.6-3.3s: bounce chain: the sneaker flies and ricochets off the left wall, the ceiling edge and the floor; each hit drops a green stroke into place, and the second "脫" lands on the third hit.
3.3-5.0s: the car overshoots to the right edge, lurches back and bumps the last stroke home; the glyph 脫 stands complete with a squeak.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "脫鞋" the car calmly wiggles off his other three sneakers one by one, they land in a neat row, and he rolls a tiny happy circle, googly eyes wobbling, away from the glyph.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "脫、脫、脫鞋" (ㄊㄨㄛ、ㄊㄨㄛ、ㄊㄨㄛ ㄒㄧㄝˊ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 脫.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.

conceptZh: 發條鯊魚和橡膠恐龍穿著大雨鞋、圍著長圍巾用泡棉劍決鬥，鯊魚咬錯咬掉恐龍的雨鞋，兩人轉圈撞頭「碰」，雨鞋、圍巾、泡棉劍全被震掉飛起來落成「脫」，最後鯊魚一邊轉圈一邊把自己最後一隻雨鞋也甩掉。
object: a chunky wind-up toy shark and a rubber dinosaur, both wearing oversized rain boots and long wool scarves, dueling with foam swords on a small round mat
morph: the head-bonk impact pops the boots, scarves and foam swords off both toys; the flying pieces land and settle into the solid blue strokes of 脫, the 月 on the left and 兌 on the right
creativeAngle: 改用「友誼決鬥」模式，而非前版賽車脫鞋彈跳。鯊魚的特質（亂咬、咬錯、在陸地轉圈）直接變成笨拙的決鬥：牠想咬泡棉劍卻咬掉恐龍的雨鞋；恐龍手太短只能用全身揮劍。撞頭的一瞬間把所有穿戴物「脫」掉飛成字，讓撞擊本身就是「脫」的意思，聲音「脫掉」落在鯊魚甩掉最後一隻雨鞋的畫面上，聽到和看到的是同一件事。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip, bright but soft: a pale butter-yellow backdrop and a small round sky-blue mat, nothing busy behind. Two toy characters only. Lead: a chunky wind-up toy shark, glossy grey with a big white grin, googly eyes and a silver winding key whirring on its back; it chomps at everything, always bites the wrong thing, and spins in circles on dry land. Rival: a soft rubber dinosaur, mint green, with enormous flat feet and comically tiny arms that reach nothing, so it swings with its whole body. Both wear oversized red rain boots and long striped wool scarves, and each holds a foam sword. The finished glyph 脫 is a saturated royal blue, centered, about 70% of frame height with clear margins, 月 on the left and 兌 on the right.

0.0-1.5s: showdown pose on the mat, shark on the left, dinosaur on the right. The shark locks eyes on the dinosaur's foam sword and chomps the air hungrily, key whirring. First "脫" as the shark lunges forward with a huge wind-up.
1.5-3.3s: the shark misses the sword completely and bites the dinosaur's left rain boot instead, yanking it clean off. The dinosaur hops on one giant foot, tries to swing its sword with its tiny arms, cannot reach, so it twists its whole body in a wild swing that also misses. Both spin a full circle from the momentum, scarves flaring.
3.3-5.0s: a frozen beat, both dizzy and cross-eyed, then they wobble straight into each other: BOINK, heads bump with cartoon squash-and-stretch. The impact pops everything loose: boots, scarves and both foam swords fly up and land one by one as the strokes, settling into solid blue; second "脫" lands exactly as the last stroke of 兌 snaps into place and 脫 stands complete. Both toys sit down dazed with big grins.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still and uncovered. The word "脫掉" is spoken as the shark, still sitting at bottom-left, kicks its own last rain boot off its tail fin; it flips in the air and lands upside down beside it. The shark offers a fin to shake, the dinosaur's tiny arm cannot reach, so it leans its whole body over and they bump fins at bottom-left, then the shark spins one small happy circle on the spot, well away from the strokes.

Audio: off-screen voice only, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "脫、脫、脫掉" (ㄊㄨㄛ、ㄊㄨㄛ、ㄊㄨㄛ ㄉㄧㄠˋ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. Soft cartoon squeaks and one gentle boink, quieter than the voice. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 脫. No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
